arxiv-2012-06952.title: An overview of SPSA: recent development and applications
arxiv-2012-06952.creator: Chen Wang Department of Mathematics
arxiv-2012-06952.description: Abstract There is an increasing need in solving high-dimensional optimization problems under non-deterministic environment. The simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA) algorithm has recently attracted considerable attention for solving high-dimensional optimization problems where the analytical formula cannot be attained. SPSA is designed to estimate the gradient by applying perturbation on a random subset of dimensions at each iteration.

arxiv-2202-09484.title: Missing Data Infill with Automunge
arxiv-2202-09484.creator: Nicholas J. Teague
arxiv-2202-09484.description: Abstract Missing data is a fundamental obstacle in the practice of data science. This paper surveys a few conventions for imputation as available in the Automunge open source python library platform for tabular data preprocessing, including “ML infill” in which auto ML models are trained for target features from partitioned extracts of a training set.

arxiv-2206-05192.title: Observation of \PGt lepton pair production in ultraperipheral lead-lead collisions at \sqrtsNN = 5.02 ​ \TeV \sqrtsNN=5.02\TeV
arxiv-2206-05192.description: Abstract We present an observation of photon-photon production of \PGt lepton pairs in ultraperipheral lead-lead collisions. The measurement is based on a data sample with an integrated luminosity of 404 \mubinv collected by the CMS experiment at a center-of-mass energy per nucleon pair of \sqrtsNN = 5.02 ​ \TeV \sqrtsNN=5.02\TeV .

arxiv-2306-10348.title: Typo-Robust Representation Learning for Dense Retrieval
arxiv-2306-10348.creator: Panuthep Tasawong, Wuttikorn Ponwitayarat, Peerat Limkonchotiwat, Can Udomcharoenchaikit, Ekapol Chuangsuwanich, Sarana Nutanong
arxiv-2306-10348.description: Abstract Dense retrieval is a basic building block of information retrieval applications. One of the main challenges of dense retrieval in real-world settings is the handling of queries containing misspelled words. A popular approach for handling misspelled queries is minimizing the representations discrepancy between misspelled queries and their pristine ones.

arxiv-2312-07660.title: Warm Surprises from Cold Duets: N N -Body Simulations with Two-Component Dark Matter
arxiv-2312-07660.creator: Jeong Han Kim, Kyoungchul Kong, Se Hwan Lim, Jong-Chul Park
arxiv-2312-07660.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jeong Han Kim, Kyoungchul Kong, Se Hwan Lim, Jong-Chul Park. We explore extensive N N -body simulations with two-component cold dark matter candidates. We delve into the temperature evolution, power spectrum, density perturbation, and maximum circular velocity functions.

arxiv-2405-19813.title: SLAM-based Joint Calibration of Multiple Asynchronous Microphone Arrays and Sound Source Localization Thanks: This paper was accepted to and going to appear in the IEEE Transactions on Robotics . Thanks: Jiang Wang, Yuanzheng He, and He Kong (corresponding author) are with the Shenzhen Key Laborator
arxiv-2405-19813.creator: Jiang Wang, Yuanzheng He, Daobilige Su, Katsutoshi Itoyama, Kazuhiro Nakadai, Junfeng Wu, Shoudong Huang
arxiv-2405-19813.description: Abstract Robot audition systems with multiple microphone arrays have many applications in practice. However, accurate calibration of multiple microphone arrays remains challenging because there are many unknown parameters to be identified, including the relative transforms (i.e., orientation, translation) and asynchronous factors (i.e., initial time offset and sampling clock difference) between microphone arrays.

arxiv-2504-09078.title: Role of Intra-specific Competition and Additional Food on Prey-Predator Systems exhibiting Holling Type-IV Functional Response
arxiv-2504-09078.creator: D Bhanu Prakash, D K K Vamsi
arxiv-2504-09078.description: Abstract In recent years, the study on the impact of competition on additional food provided prey-predator systems have gained significant attention from researchers in the field of mathematical biology. In this study, we consider an additional food provided prey-predator model exhibiting Holling type-IV functional response and the intra-specific competition among predators.

arxiv-2506-14539.title: Doppelgänger Method : Breaking Role Consistency in LLM Agent via Prompt-based Transferable Adversarial Attack
arxiv-2506-14539.creator: Daewon Kang, YeongHwan Shin, Doyeon Kim, Kyu-Hwan Jung Meong Hi Son
arxiv-2506-14539.description: Abstract Since the advent of large language models, prompt engineering now enables the rapid, low-effort creation of diverse autonomous agents that are already in widespread use. Yet this convenience raises urgent concerns about the safety, robustness, and behavioural consistency of the underlying prompts—along with the pressing challenge of preventing those prompts from being exposed to user’s attempts.

arxiv-2511-22127.title: Connexive logics and connexive semi-Heyting algebras
arxiv-2511-22127.creator: Juan M. CORNEJO* and Hanamantagouda P. Sankappanavar
arxiv-2511-22127.description: Abstract . In this paper, we define and investigate a connexive logic, called “Connexive semi-Heyting logic” ( 𝒞 ​ 𝒮 ​ ℋ \mathcal{CSH} for short) and a new subvariety ℂ ​ 𝕊 ​ ℍ \mathbb{CSH} of the variety 𝕊 ​ ℍ \mathbb{SH} of semi-Heyting algebras.

pmc-10563010.title: Exosomes released from PD-L1+ tumor associated macrophages promote peritoneal metastasis of epithelial ovarian cancer by up-regulating T cell lipid metabolism
pmc-10563010.creator: Jun Ma, Qianqian Cen, Qingzhu Wang, Li Liu, Jieru Zhou
pmc-10563010.description: Epithelial ovarian cancer (EOC) tends to metastasize to the peritoneum, and the prognosis of patients is poor. In the peritoneum of patients with EOC, TAMs (tumor associated macrophages) regulate the imbalance of T cell ratio and promote the progression and metastasis of EOC. However, the mechanism of peritoneal metastasis in EOC patients remains unclear.

pmc-11465076.title: Myositis ossificans circumscripta of the thigh: A pediatric case report
pmc-11465076.creator: Chaymae Faraj, Sara Essetti, Yahya El Harras, Najlae Lrhorfi, Nidal Mrani Alaoui, Mohamed Anouar Dendane, Abdelouahed Amrani, Sidi Zouhair El Fellous El Alami, Tarik El Madhi, Nazik Allali, Siham El Haddad, Latifa Chat
pmc-11465076.description: Circumscribed myositis ossificans is a benign process of focal heterotopic ossification of the soft tissues, occurring in young subjects, usually following trauma. We report a case of a 15-year-old patient who suffered a direct trauma to the thigh during a soccer match, and developed a hard mass in the anterior face of the thigh.

pmc-11589240.title: Evaluation of Medically Reversible Limbal Stem Cell Deficiency
pmc-11589240.creator: İlayda Korkmaz, Nihat Furkan Eratılgan, Melis Palamar, Sait Eğrilmez, Ayşe Yağcı, Özlem Barut Selver
pmc-11589240.description: ObjectivesTo evaluate the clinical characteristics and treatment strategies of limbal stem cell deficiency (LSCD) patients managed with medical therapy.Materials and MethodsThe study included 29 eyes of 21 patients with LSCD who were managed medically at Ege University Faculty of Medicine, Department of Ophthalmology between May 2013 and May 2023.

pmc-12416792.title: Lineage Switch of Adult B-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia to Acute Myeloid Leukaemia Following B-Cell-Directed Therapy
pmc-12416792.creator: Oscar F. Borja-Montes, Darrel D. Horton, Alejandro Toro-Pedroza, Tomas Escobar-Gil, Daniel Babu, Charles Foucar, Ala Ebaid
pmc-12416792.description: BackgroundBlinatumomab and inotuzumab ozogamicin (InO) are B-cell targeted agents used in the frontline and relapsed/refractory treatment of B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (B-ALL). Blinatumomab, a bispecific T-cell engager that targets CD19 and CD3, and InO, an antibody-drug conjugate targeting CD22, have both shown efficacy.

pmc-13011451.title: Comparing mental health professionals’ willingness to use digital therapeutics: a cross-national survey in South Korea and Germany
pmc-13011451.creator: Daa Un Moon, Shinjae Park, Min-Ji Kim, Stefan Gutwinski, Felix Bermpohl, Malek Bajbouj, Hong Jin Jeon, Alva Lütt
pmc-13011451.description: BackgroundDigital therapeutics (DTx) are software-based medical interventions used to prevent, manage, or treat health conditions. As mental health DTx become more prevalent, understanding clinicians’ willingness to use them and the systemic and individual factors that shape that willingness is critical for effective implementation. This study aimed to compare perceptions of DTx among mental health professionals in South Korea and Germany.

pmc-13096502.title: Rapid peptide analysis in dried bloodspots to identify novel markers for newborn screening for congenital hypothyroidism
pmc-13096502.creator: Jaranee Phoungphosop, Teerakul Arpornsuwan, Janthima Jaresitthikunchai, Narumon Phaonakrop, Siriwan Thaisakul, Penpan Thongngao, Piyanan Thiplakorn, Sittiruk Roytrakul, Piamnukul Krasao
pmc-13096502.description: Early diagnosis of Congenital Hypothyroidism (CH) is critical to prevent irreversible neurodevelopmental damage. However, current TSH-based newborn screening using Dried Blood Spots (DBS) is limited by factors that lead to false-positive and false-negative results, necessitating the development of alternative methods. Matrix-Assisted Laser Desorption Ionization Time-of-Flight Mass Spectrometry (MALDI-TOF MS) as a high-throughput solution was investigated.

pmc-13187114.title: Cytoplasmic cyclin D1 modulates brain cortex development
pmc-13187114.creator: Neus Pedraza, Daniel Rocandio, Bahira Zammou, Maria Ventura Monserrat, Ariadna Ortiz-Brugués, Pau Marfull-Oromí, Disha Chauhan, Mario Encinas, Xavier Dolcet, Francisco Ferrezuelo, Eloi Garí, Joaquim Egea
pmc-13187114.description: During nervous system development, the interplay between cell cycle regulation and neurogenesis is fundamental to achieving the correct timing for neuronal differentiation. However, the molecules regulating this transition are poorly understood. Among these, the cell-cycle regulatory cyclins and their cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs) play a pivotal role.

pmc-13258704.title: Image-Based Classification of Concrete Carbonation Using YOLO Models
pmc-13258704.creator: Yaren Aydın, Ümit Işıkdağ, Sinan Melih Nigdeli, Gebrail Bekdaş, Celal Cakiroglu
pmc-13258704.description: Detecting the presence of carbonation is critical for monitoring structural safety and durability. Identifying the presence of carbonation reveals the risk of chemical changes within the concrete and the potential for reinforcement corrosion. This detection allows for a reliable and prioritized assessment of the structure’s current condition.

pmc-13453354.title: The Role of Serum Albumin as a Prognostic Marker in Guillain-Barré Syndrome: A Systematic Review
pmc-13453354.creator: Vivien Puspitasari, Yang Yang Endro Arjuna, Alexander Erick Purnomo, Yusak Mangara Tua Siahaan
pmc-13453354.description: Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) is an immune-mediated neuropathy typically triggered by infection. Prognosis is primarily based on clinical features and established scoring systems. Serum albumin, a biomarker reduced in systemic inflammation, has demonstrated prognostic value in various conditions. This study aims to investigate the correlation between serum albumin levels and clinical outcomes in patients with GBS.

pmc-13558491.title: Validating the biological origin of in vivo fractional intracellular volume from VERDICT-MRI in the prostate
pmc-13558491.creator: Marta Masramon, Manju Mathew, Saurabh Singh, Thomy Mertzanidou, Joey Clemente, Adam Retter, Natasha Thorley, Adam Phipps, Thomas Parry, Marianti-Vasiliki Papoutsaki, Lorna Smith, Francesco Grussu, Veeru Kasivisvanathan, Alistair Grey, Eoin Dinneen, Greg Shaw, Dominic Patel, Lucy Caselton, Caroline M
pmc-13558491.description: ObjectiveNoninvasive microstructure estimates using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) show potential in improving prostate cancer (PCa) diagnosis; however, histological validation is necessary.Materials and methodsWe used data from the Histo-MRI trial (NCT04792138). Participants with biopsy-confirmed PCa underwent multiparametric (mp) MRI and “vascular, extracellular, and restricted diffusion for cytometry in tumors” (VERDICT)-MRI before radical prostatectomy.

pmc-13649085.title: Report of Adverse Events Associated With Cutaneous Procedures: Update From the CAPER Registry
pmc-13649085.creator: Sabrina S. Smith, Michael D. Yi, Elizabeth Zhang, Joycie Chang, Thanvi Gullapalli, Doroteja Dragovic, Vanessa J. Lazaro‐Camp, Ashish C. Bhatia, Arisa Ortiz, Murad Alam
pmc-13649085.description: ObjectivesTo systematically evaluate submissions to the CAPER database by analyzing procedural context, characteristics of reported adverse events (AEs), and provider involvement in order to identify patterns with potential implications for patient safety.MethodsA retrospective review of all reports submitted to the CAPER database from March 2021 to August 2025 was conducted, categorizing cases by procedure type, reported AE, and provider involved.

uslaw-usc-t16-s160.title: 16 U.S.C. § 160 — Congressional declaration of purpose
uslaw-usc-t16-s160.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s160.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter XIX (Voyageurs National Park). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The purpose of this subchapter is to preserve, for the inspiration and enjoyment of present and future generations, the outstanding scenery, geological conditions, and waterway system which constituted a part of the historic route of the Voyageurs.
